quotes.name: Screaming Phantom
quotes.flavor: After a slow death in darkness, she flies into a rage at the slightest glimpse of light.

quotes.name: Crystalline Entity
quotes.flavor:
"Ironic, isn't it? That something so unique could care so little for the diversity of life."
—Captain Jean-Luc Picard

quotes.name: Ohran Viper
quotes.flavor: The ohran viper is not cold-blooded. Its veins course with the same antigelid venom used to kill its prey.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Marhault Elsdragon
quotes.flavor: Marhault Elsdragon follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

quotes.name: Crossbow Infantry
quotes.flavor:
"He can split a marshfly in two from halfway across the range."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Gold-Forged Thopteryx
quotes.flavor: Worlds apart, Huatli built a device Saheeli would have been proud of.

quotes.name: United Front
quotes.flavor:
"When this is finished, the Avatar will have defeated the Fire Lord, we will have control of the Fire Nation capital, and this war will be over!"
—Hakoda

quotes.name: Tishana's Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: "There is always another way."

quotes.name: Mutant's Prey
quotes.flavor: Every street corner is a hunting ground, every citizen potential prey.

quotes.name: Hunted Wumpus
quotes.flavor: Just one can feed a dozen people for a month.

quotes.name: Ghirapur Guide
quotes.flavor: Fairgoers were delighted to find that even outside the fairgrounds, Ghirapur was a city of wonders.

quotes.name: Maelstrom Pulse
quotes.flavor: During the collision of the shards, entire ways of life disappeared without a trace.

quotes.name: Violent Ultimatum
quotes.flavor:
"Words are a waste of time. Destruction is a language everyone understands."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Thundermare
quotes.flavor: Its hooves strike lightning and the thunder follows quickly after.

quotes.name: Shield Wall
quotes.flavor: もっとも堅牢な壁とは、石の壁でも鋼の壁でもなく、力を合わせた戦士たちの壁である。

quotes.name: Nourish
quotes.flavor: Gelfruit grows abundantly wherever Sylvok druids live, as if the Tangle knows that humans are not as hardy as the beasts or as nimble as the elves.

quotes.name: Bison Whistle
quotes.flavor:
"I knew a bison whistle would come in handy."
—Aang

quotes.name: Elvish Skysweeper
quotes.flavor: The spires of Ravnica are no different from the tall trees of other planes. The elves navigate and protect them just the same.

quotes.name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
quotes.flavor: To be Arbiter is to dispense few words and many judgments.

quotes.name: Stormwatch Eagle
quotes.flavor: When eagles leave the sky, sailors leave the sea.

quotes.name: Hedgewitch's Mask
quotes.flavor: In Kessig, even celebration wears a fearsome face.

quotes.name: Retrieval Agent
quotes.flavor: The humming tome burned his leather glove, nearly taking his hand along with it. Then a strange power coursed through him.

quotes.name: Serra Avenger
quotes.flavor:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

quotes.name: Cinder Crawler
quotes.flavor: The crawler doesn't care what gets in its way. It pushes everything into the boiling muck and waits for the meal to cook.

quotes.name: Fracture
quotes.flavor:
"Your defiance is amusing, little mage. It's time you learn how fragile you really are."
—Extus Narr

quotes.name: Heronblade Elite
quotes.flavor: "When angels fall, humans must rise."

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Harmattan Efreet
quotes.flavor:
"One moment I was walking along the beach, and the next I was high in the air, staring into a hideous smiling face."
—Tarub, Suq'Ata sailor

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

quotes.name: Wheel of Potential
quotes.flavor: The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.

quotes.name: Jailbreak
quotes.flavor: Obscura spies rarely stay locked up long enough to make it to trial.

quotes.name: Reprocess
quotes.flavor: Everything will find its use in Phyrexia. Eventually.

quotes.name: Castigate
quotes.flavor:
"We have no need for military might. We wield two of the sharpest swords ever forged: Faith in our left hand, Wealth in our right."
—Vuliev of the Ghost Council

quotes.name: Elvish Pioneer
quotes.flavor: "Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."

quotes.name: Expressive Iteration
quotes.flavor: Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.

quotes.name: Reckless Crew
quotes.flavor: "Boat's burning! Row faster!"

quotes.name: Viashino Sandstalker
quotes.flavor:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

quotes.name: Cheeky House-Mouse // Squeak By
quotes.flavor: "Get back here, vile rodent! I was almost done cursing that ring!"

quotes.name: Dive Down
quotes.flavor: "Seeing the river is not the same as seeing the fish."

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor:
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny."
—*Aethershrine*, inscription

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor:
"As Horus once besieged the Sol System, we shall bring the rotting Imperium to its knees."
—Abaddon the Despoiler

quotes.name: Game-Trail Changeling
quotes.flavor:
"I pity them, never knowing the pleasures of a single familiar form, but at least they find a noble shape at times."
—Desmera, perfect of Wren's Run

quotes.name: Fog Bank
quotes.flavor:
"The union of sea and sky makes a perfect cover."
—Talrand, sky summoner

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: The Barrow-downs had as sinister a reputation in Hobbit-legend as the Forest itself.

quotes.name: Boon of Erebos
quotes.flavor:
"Death is not a certainty. Erebos determines when a mortal's time is up."
—Iadorna, death priest of Erebos

quotes.name: Stromkirk Mentor
quotes.flavor: The lineage of Runo Stromkirk is known for producing some of Nephalia's greatest fencing masters.

quotes.name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
quotes.flavor: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

quotes.name: Blasphemous Edict
quotes.flavor:
"A demonic pact is all fun and games until the bill comes due."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Seeker of the Way
quotes.flavor: "I don't know where my destiny lies, but I know it isn't here."

quotes.name: Modify Memory
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Percival's clothes itched and his dinner was unpleasantly wriggly, but the kobold looked like he was having the time of his life.

quotes.name: Haughty Djinn
quotes.flavor: "I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic."

quotes.name: Reckless Detective
quotes.flavor: He's gonna crack this thing wide open.

quotes.name: Satyr Enchanter
quotes.flavor: "The threads of magic that protect this place were woven by my will."

quotes.name: Storm Herd
quotes.flavor:
"When you hear thunder on a cloudless day, take cover and brace for the coming of the storm herd."
—Skotov, Tin Street basket vendor

quotes.name: Go for the Throat
quotes.flavor: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Magmaquake
quotes.flavor:
"Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?"
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Guardian Lions
quotes.flavor: Approach in peace or not at all.

quotes.name: Sister Hospitaller
quotes.flavor:
"Ours is to honour the martyr, tend the fallen, defend the innocent, and walk always in the light."
—*The Hospitaller's Book of Hours*

quotes.name: Shenanigans
quotes.flavor: Pricy baubles are no match for cheap tricks.

quotes.name: Repurposing Bay
quotes.flavor: By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.

quotes.name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
quotes.flavor: "Sign or don't, it makes little difference to me. It is your fate that hangs in the balance."

quotes.name: The Mindskinner
quotes.flavor: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

quotes.name: Springmane Cervin
quotes.flavor: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.

quotes.name: Skitter Eel
quotes.flavor:
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Ojutai Interceptor
quotes.flavor: "Though I may soar, I could never fly as high as the dragons."

quotes.name: Squirrel Nest
quotes.flavor: In the treetops, unseen by many, lurks chittering, skittering death.

quotes.name: Frontline Rebel
quotes.flavor: "Will you be strong and stand with me?"

quotes.name: Strength of Arms
quotes.flavor:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

quotes.name: Valley Dasher
quotes.flavor: Mardu riders' greatest fear is that a battle might end before their weapons draw blood.

quotes.name: Castle Ardenvale
quotes.flavor: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

quotes.name: Kessig Cagebreakers
quotes.flavor: "They put bars on these noble beasts and then wonder why werewolves target our towns."

quotes.name: Charix, the Raging Isle
quotes.flavor: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.

quotes.name: Lava Dart
quotes.flavor:
"Small outbursts are healthy."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Wanderguard Sentry
quotes.flavor: It allows those with dangerous weapons to pass. But not those with dangerous thoughts.

quotes.name: The Mary Janes
quotes.flavor:
"You gotta FACE IT TIGER! FACE IT TIGER!"
—"Face It Tiger"

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: New Perspectives
quotes.flavor: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

quotes.name: Surgespanner
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: They ride on waves of aether, washing out anything that might pollute the Merrow Lanes.

quotes.name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
quotes.flavor: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

quotes.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
quotes.flavor: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

quotes.name: Clifftop Retreat
quotes.flavor: The sunlight falls pristine on the temple at Epityr, softened by the remembered shadows of angelic saviors' wings.

quotes.name: Cartographer's Survey
quotes.flavor: She monitors the roads in every province, mapping safe routes through hunting grounds and haunting grounds alike.

quotes.name: Tezzeret's Betrayal
quotes.flavor:
"You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Tunnel Ignus
quotes.flavor: Fight mischief with mischief.

quotes.name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: Crafted from the poisoned bones of wyverns by Snake Mountain's first inhabitants.

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Kavu Climber
quotes.flavor:
"There was a crack of branches, a rustle of leaves, then a tremendous roar. Our party had no chance as death descended from above."
—Taseen, elvish bard

quotes.name: Honor Guard
quotes.flavor: The strength of one. The courage of ten.

quotes.name: Elusive Spellfist
quotes.flavor:
"Learn to see an obstacle from a new perspective. Underneath, for example."
—Chanyi, Ojutai monk

quotes.name: Band Together
quotes.flavor: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

quotes.name: Lurching Rotbeast
quotes.flavor: The dead that swept across Naktamun came in all shapes and sizes.

quotes.name: Woolly Loxodon
quotes.flavor: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

quotes.name: Fblthp, Knows the Way
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always loved to travel.

quotes.name: Glacial Fortress
quotes.flavor:
"Avengers Mountain is built inside of a Celestial corpse. Weird? Yes. But we go jogging in the femoral artery, so it has its perks."
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

quotes.name: Entity Tracker
quotes.flavor: "The readings are off the charts! Whatever it is, it's close."

quotes.name: Aerial Doombot
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen your rightful place. Beneath me."
—Doctor Doom

quotes.name: Polymorph
quotes.flavor: "Ahh! Opposable digits!"

quotes.name: Tibalt's Rager
quotes.flavor:
"Find out whose that is. I like its energy."
—Judith

quotes.name: Imperial Seal
quotes.flavor:
"Your presence at the palace this evening is required."
—Letter from Queen Marchesa

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Undying Rage
quotes.flavor: Radha was born in Skyshroud, but her temper is undeniably Keldon.

quotes.name: Raging Swordtooth
quotes.flavor: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.

quotes.name: Frodo Baggins
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Few have ever come hither through greater peril or on an errand more urgent."
—Elrond

quotes.name: Frostbite Pyromental
quotes.flavor: It's a contradiction in burns.

quotes.name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
quotes.flavor: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

quotes.name: Shake the Foundations
quotes.flavor: A threefold calamity with a single will.

quotes.name: Squee, the Immortal
quotes.flavor:
Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both.
—*Heroes of the Second Invasion*

quotes.name: Thaumatic Compass // Spires of Orazca
quotes.flavor:
"Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of . . ."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Anarchist
quotes.flavor: "I'll take that. You won't need it when the revolution comes."

quotes.name: Jolly Gerbils
quotes.flavor: "With all the chaos going around, we thought it might be the perfect time to take a break and have a nice picnic. Would you like to join us?"

quotes.name: Scrap Welder
quotes.flavor: "This big metal guy will make some amazing wind chimes!"

quotes.name: Mayhem Devil
quotes.flavor: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Thought Vessel
quotes.flavor: Unlimited potential needs only a spark of ambition.

quotes.name: Gearseeker Serpent
quotes.flavor: Its collection is vast, yet each ship has a special place in its heart.

quotes.name: Tombfire
quotes.flavor: The fondest memories burn brightest. As they're lost forever, the flames grow hotter still.

quotes.name: Spined Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"I wouldn't stand in front of that wurm, son. 'Course, I wouldn't stand behind it neither. In fact, standing anywhere near that wurm's not much of a plan. Running, now *that's* a plan!"
—Wandering mage

quotes.name: Apocalypse Runner
quotes.flavor:
"Don't avoid the wreck. Survive it."
—Far Fortune

quotes.name: Invigorating Falls
quotes.flavor: Krosan druids do not fear death, for they know that nature will only prosper from their passing.

quotes.name: Zombie Master
quotes.flavor: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

quotes.name: Holy Day
quotes.flavor:
"The day of Spirits; my soul's calm retreat / Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "The Night"

quotes.name: Biolume Egg // Biolume Serpent
quotes.flavor: ...knowing their hatchlings are more fearsome than anything else that might come along.

quotes.name: Desertion
quotes.flavor: First the insult, then the injury.

quotes.name: Uncivil Unrest
quotes.flavor: The mob had only one rule: Never stop dancing.

quotes.name: Prismite
quotes.flavor: It didn't budge when the portal opened, nor when the ancient gods emerged. It came to life only when all ten guilds came together to face a common threat.

quotes.name: Annul
quotes.flavor:
"Why pray to the gods, who feed on your worship? Dissolve your illusions and see the true nature of things."
—Xenagos, the Reveler

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Relic of Legends
quotes.flavor:
"A smile better suits a hero."
—Haurchefant Greystone

quotes.name: Loot, the Nexus
quotes.flavor:
"Within Loot's mind were the blueprints I needed to complete this new Multiverse. He gave me hope. Tell him that, Vraska."
—Jace

quotes.name: Ghazbán Ogre
quotes.flavor:
"We were holding our own—until the ogre guiding us suddenly grinned and turned on our commander."
—Ivra Jursdotter, Sarpadian mercenary

quotes.name: White Knight
quotes.flavor: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

quotes.name: Plague Sliver
quotes.flavor: A sliver shares everything with its hive—even its afflictions.

quotes.name: Drown in Filth
quotes.flavor: The rot farmer's first rite of passage is to craft a pair of work stilts.

quotes.name: Unbender Tine
quotes.flavor: Creations made in madness may contain great power. The path to that power is as labyrinthine as the creator's mind.

quotes.name: Neurok Replica
quotes.flavor: All the curiosity of the Neurok with only a trace of their duplicity.

quotes.name: Flowstone Overseer
quotes.flavor: The rebels couldn't see where the roar was coming from. Then they saw it was coming from everywhere.

quotes.name: Alaborn Trooper
quotes.flavor:
"I dedicate my body to my country And my life to my King."
—Alaborn Soldier's Oath

quotes.name: Challenger Troll
quotes.flavor: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

quotes.name: Key to the City
quotes.flavor:
"Presented to the Chief Artificer in recognition of his unparalleled service to Yotia."
—Rusted plaque

quotes.name: Goblin Elite Infantry
quotes.flavor:
We're *elite*. You're not.
—Infantry motto

quotes.name: Sustainer of the Realm
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: You may break her shield, but you'll never break her spirit.

quotes.name: Amrou Seekers
quotes.flavor: The paradise of Amrou Haven had become a field of cinders. Its people struggled to survive, hoping to see visions of its past in the strange storms that quickly passed.

quotes.name: Gloomlake Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

quotes.name: Kozilek's Translator
quotes.flavor: From nothingness, sustenance.

quotes.name: Peel from Reality
quotes.flavor: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

quotes.name: Gandalf, White Rider
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and the enemy shall fear him.

quotes.name: Gifted Aetherborn
quotes.flavor: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

quotes.name: Merfolk of the Pearl Trident
quotes.flavor: Most human scholars believe that Merfolk are the survivors of sunken Atlantis, humans adapted to the water. Merfolk, however, believe that humans sprang forth from Merfolk who adapted themselves in order to explore their last frontier.

quotes.name: Repeal
quotes.flavor:
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be."
—Agosto, Azorius imperator

quotes.name: Malfegor
quotes.flavor: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

quotes.name: Magus of the Wheel
quotes.flavor: "Fate is not as fixed as you might think."

quotes.name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
quotes.flavor: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

quotes.name: By Invitation Only
quotes.flavor: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor: Which is more unsettling: the roar of battle or the silence that follows?

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Greater Forgeling
quotes.flavor: Few have seen the inner workings of Ravnica's furnaces, but neighboring districts catch brief glimpses in the horrors that escape the flames.

quotes.name: Chromatic Orrery
quotes.flavor: Visitors marvel at its design, unaware of the other world that inspired it.

quotes.name: Souls of the Lost
quotes.flavor: "Do you remember us?"

quotes.name: Fumarole
quotes.flavor:
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills."
—Klazina Jansdotter, leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

quotes.name: Woodland Druid
quotes.flavor: What is a tree? Slow hard thought. What is a flower? Swift soft flesh. What is a druid? Both.

quotes.name: Mob Lookout
quotes.flavor:
"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead

quotes.name: Mary Jane Watson
quotes.flavor: Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.

quotes.name: Skyseer's Chariot
quotes.flavor: "It's the dawn of a new era, and we shall rise like the suns to greet it."

quotes.name: Urabrask the Hidden
quotes.flavor: When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."

quotes.name: Collected Company
quotes.flavor: Many can stand where one would fall.

quotes.name: Deathmark
quotes.flavor:
"I hope it's true that every snowflake is unique, because I never want to see one like this again. Now clean up that body."
—Thangbrand Gyrdsson, Kjeldoran patrol

quotes.name: Bookwurm
quotes.flavor: It takes "devouring a book in one sitting" to a frightening extreme.

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor:
"He's more mutagen than mutant!"
—Donatello

quotes.name: Icatian Town
quotes.flavor: Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

quotes.name: Pyre Charger
quotes.flavor: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

quotes.name: Clockwork Percussionist
quotes.flavor: Dance to its beat, or it will dance on your grave.

quotes.name: Guardians' Pledge
quotes.flavor: A dozen fighting for each other are worth a thousand fighting for themselves.

quotes.name: Troop of Ponies
quotes.flavor: The sun had only just turned west when they started on the path to Mirkwood, and till evening it lay golden on the land about them.

quotes.name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: The true strength of nature is not the raging storm or the charging rhino, but the inexorable vitality of life.

quotes.name: Day of Judgment
quotes.flavor: Sin appeared a thousand years ago, a raging demon intent on reducing Spira to rubble. Everyone in Spira lives under Sin's black shadow.

quotes.name: Wall of Brambles
quotes.flavor: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

quotes.name: Heated Argument
quotes.flavor: "I don't want to hurt you, Ajani, but whatever Jace is planning needs to be stopped!"

quotes.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
quotes.flavor: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

quotes.name: Lake-town Toymaker
quotes.flavor: In the great days of old, when Dale in the North was rich and prosperous, Lake-town flourished.

quotes.name: Remove Soul
quotes.flavor: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

quotes.name: Kami of Ancient Law
quotes.flavor:
"Duty and law are the foundation on which civilization stands. They must not fall, for when they do, they take everything with them."
—Lord Konda

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground."
—Sidar Jabari

quotes.name: Genesis
quotes.flavor: Not dryad, centaur, or avatar but life itself.

quotes.name: Fangren Marauder
quotes.flavor:
"The fangren fight without comfort of any kind. We can ask no less of ourselves."
—Tilien, Sylvok partisan

quotes.name: Booster Tutor
quotes.flavor: Make your judgment wisely: The right pack will let you defeat your nemesis, but a poor choice can only end in torment. And *Homelands*.

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Bonecaller Cleric
quotes.flavor: "My blood was never my own. I carried it gladly for the Hungering One, and at last she arises to reclaim it."

quotes.name: Longshot, Rebel Bowman
quotes.flavor: He rarely used words, but then again, he rarely needed them.

quotes.name: Iron Myr
quotes.flavor: The goblins didn't think of the myr at all, which allowed the myr to observe everywhere unhindered.

quotes.name: Wretched Throng
quotes.flavor:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

quotes.name: Zuran Orb
quotes.flavor:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Mass of Ghouls
quotes.flavor:
"An army has filled the valley, but it's not like any army I've ever seen. There are no tents, no fires, no horses . . . just a sea of bodies, writhing and moaning, as if a pestilent village were sent to invade us."
—Onean scout

quotes.name: Inquisition of Kozilek
quotes.flavor: You have been found wanting, though not for much longer.

quotes.name: Crystacean
quotes.flavor: It loves blending into its environment, ambushing prey, and long scuttles on the beach.

quotes.name: Caress of Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: "I am weak. Make . . . me . . . ideal."

quotes.name: Aether Gust
quotes.flavor: The chill wind extinguishes flame, and frosts the leaf on the branch.

quotes.name: For the Family
quotes.flavor: The Cabaretti cultivate an image of harmless hedonism, happy for the other families to underestimate their formidable firepower.

quotes.name: Ivy Elemental
quotes.flavor: For safety reasons, the keeping of houseplants within Ikoria's sanctuaries is heavily discouraged.

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: "You have not died until I consent."

quotes.name: Ethereal Haze
quotes.flavor:
"Imagine a dove flying through smoke. Does the dove injure the smoke? Does the smoke impede the dove?"
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

quotes.name: Galestrike
quotes.flavor: Strong wings make strong winds.

quotes.name: Samwise the Stouthearted
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it."

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

quotes.name: Spinnerette, Arachnobat
quotes.flavor: High-wire injuries are down 95%. Spider-related injuries are up 3000%.

quotes.name: Daru Spiritualist
quotes.flavor: He lifts the spirits of his people so they may descend in wrath upon their foes.

quotes.name: Lead by Example
quotes.flavor: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

quotes.name: Bedlam
quotes.flavor: The generals were dead. The battle plans were forgotten. It was everyone for themselves.

quotes.name: Bonders' Enclave
quotes.flavor: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor:
"You held fire in your hand, old man. It should have been destroyed."
—Altair Ibn-La'Ahad

quotes.name: Giant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"The prohibition of unnecessary tossing of the citizenry by giants shall also extend to spontaneous giants."
—Isperia's Edict, provision VII.789.2

quotes.name: Forth Eorlingas!
quotes.flavor: "A sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises! Ride now, ride now! Ride to Gondor!"

quotes.name: Laboratory Brute
quotes.flavor: It keeps intruders out and experiments in.

quotes.name: Mad Ratter
quotes.flavor: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

quotes.name: Crosstown Courier
quotes.flavor: Information travels quickly through Ravnica's network of messengers and thought agents.

quotes.name: Skywhaler's Shot
quotes.flavor: In the moment of truth, it is as though time stands still, and the whale waits, suspended in the sky.

quotes.name: Char-Rumbler
quotes.flavor: Elementals flourished as Dominaria healed and new forms of life adapted to the land's reinfusion with mana.

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
quotes.flavor:
Honorable in battle, generous in death.
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

quotes.name: Strength of Solidarity
quotes.flavor: "This expedition doesn't succeed unless we all succeed!"

quotes.name: Selfless Cathar
quotes.flavor: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."

quotes.name: Unexpectedly Absent
quotes.flavor: Once you've been dragged down the currents of time, you'll never quite trust your own permanence again.

quotes.name: Botanical Plaza
quotes.flavor: Public parks are a favored meeting spot for those considering a shift in allegiance.

quotes.name: False Demise
quotes.flavor:
"Fool! Never believe they're dead until you see the body!"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Brainstone
quotes.flavor: One day, it might provide a flash of insight that turns the tide of battle. Meanwhile, it looks lovely on an end table.

quotes.name: Copper Carapace
quotes.flavor:
"We will fight as they do: our flesh protected behind metal."
—Tae Aquil, Viridian weaponsmith

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor:
"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war."
—River Song

quotes.name: Bastion of Remembrance
quotes.flavor: In the year 2271, the Desert Rangers of Nevada and rangers of the New California Republic met at this spot to sign the Ranger Unification Treaty.

quotes.name: Wash Out
quotes.flavor:
"Rest now. You've neither won nor lost, but this battle is over for you just the same."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Shuri, the Black Panther
quotes.flavor: "Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."

quotes.name: Grave Consequences
quotes.flavor:
"You call *that* a nightmare?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
quotes.flavor: "I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Hit-Monkey
quotes.flavor:
"He's a hitman. Who's a monkey. You don't believe me. Look around you, dude—he's real!"
—Deadpool, Wade Wilson

quotes.name: Magewright's Stone
quotes.flavor: The stones hark back to an age before civilization, when the living earth blessed all who trod its untamed wilds.

quotes.name: Skulking Ghost
quotes.flavor:
"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: With the Scorched below and toxic smog above, few survived fissure site Omega.

quotes.name: Dripping-Tongue Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Life's Web was destroyed, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to ensure mortal defeat.

quotes.name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
quotes.flavor: "I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."

quotes.name: Knight in _____ Armor
quotes.flavor: The lucky armor stopped lightning and lasers, but sadly, also love.

quotes.name: Mana Geyser
quotes.flavor: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

quotes.name: Second Sunrise
quotes.flavor: The bright tunnel sometimes leads back to life.

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor:
"You're trespassing in my reality. Ask permission next time."
—Simun the Quiet

quotes.name: Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance
quotes.flavor: When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.

quotes.name: The Convention Enthusiast
quotes.flavor: Prize Card for the Unknown events at GenCon, July 31-August 3, 2025.

quotes.name: Unagi's Spray
quotes.flavor: Capable of both blasting ships to pieces and humbling showboating Avatars.

quotes.name: All-Fates Scroll
quotes.flavor: For navigating that which was, is, and will be.

quotes.name: Greenbelt Rampager
quotes.flavor: Subtlety is not a necessary part of sabotage.

quotes.name: Wall of Wood
quotes.flavor: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

quotes.name: Archon of Justice
quotes.flavor: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

quotes.name: Enraged Huorn
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"They stand watching endlessly over the trees. It is difficult to see them moving, but they can move very quickly if they are angry."
—Merry

quotes.name: Viridian Shaman
quotes.flavor: Because the elves are so in touch with Mirrodin's nature, they understand best how to dismantle it.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Star-Crowned Stag
quotes.flavor: White as starlight on snow, it appears only on the eve of the winter solstice.

quotes.name: Tenured Inkcaster
quotes.flavor: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

quotes.name: Heirloom Epic
quotes.flavor: "The beasts feared fire, and little else. Lily of Valley raised Cragflame and..."

quotes.name: Volcanic Spite
quotes.flavor: None may approach the Ashen Idol without an offering—an edict fortuitously absent from Phyrexian intelligence concerning the world of Azgol.

quotes.name: Secure the Wastes
quotes.flavor: "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter."

quotes.name: Kayla's Reconstruction
quotes.flavor: Anyone can destroy a continent. Few have the vision to rebuild one.

quotes.name: Imperious Perfect
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: In a culture of beauty, the most beautiful are worshipped as gods.

quotes.name: Planar Engineering
quotes.flavor:
"All growth comes at a cost. It's up to each of us to determine if the result is worth the sacrifice."
—Oracle Jadzi, to Tam

quotes.name: Rag Dealer
quotes.flavor:
"After General Takeno found the Oathkeeper amidst the bamboo marshes, more scavengers braved the swamp's nezumi, oni, and kami in hopes of glory."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Treasure Map // Treasure Cove
quotes.flavor: Half the treasure is the glory of finding it.

quotes.name: Switcheroo
quotes.flavor: Say hello to your new friend.

quotes.name: Tendril of the Mycotyrant
quotes.flavor: Every mycoid carries within itself the makings of an entire colony.

quotes.name: Crimson Hellkite
quotes.flavor:
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

quotes.name: Nantuko Disciple
quotes.flavor:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Megrim
quotes.flavor:
"Es un círculo vicioso. El cansancio da dolor. El dolor da cansancio. Es hermoso, ¿no crees?"
—Vradeen, nócturnus vampiro

quotes.name: Vision Skeins
quotes.flavor: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

quotes.name: Xira Arien
quotes.flavor: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

quotes.name: Leaping Master
quotes.flavor: "Strength batters down barriers. Discipline ignores them."

quotes.name: Crook of Condemnation
quotes.flavor: The God-Pharaoh's angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches and the fortifying magic they provided.

quotes.name: Earthquake
quotes.flavor: They fell screaming into the depths of the chasm like so many pebbles tossed down a well.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor:
"Well, it also makes a very nice flower pot. . . ."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi machinist

quotes.name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
quotes.flavor: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

quotes.name: Dimir Locket
quotes.flavor:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

quotes.name: Rune Snag
quotes.flavor:
"Concentration is key. Without it, a mage conjures nothing but a splitting headache."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor:
"We have inherited the mysteries of the Thran, but few of the answers."
—Jhoira

quotes.name: Engulf the Shore
quotes.flavor:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"I will show you fear in a handful of dust."
—T. S. Eliot, "The Waste Land"

quotes.name: Unstable Footing
quotes.flavor: A long way down is shorter than you think.

quotes.name: Flametongue Kavu
quotes.flavor:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

quotes.name: Hidden Gibbons
quotes.flavor: When these apes want something, it's a matter of gibbon take.

quotes.name: Harmonized Crescendo
quotes.flavor: A song can unite quicker than a sword can divide.

quotes.name: Livonya Silone
quotes.flavor: Livonya's own nature is a matter of mystery. Nothing is known for sure, merely rumors of unearthly stealth, and unholy alliances.

quotes.name: Serra Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Would that I could be a Paladin again, but the dead hold no place among their ranks."
—Ihsan's Shade

quotes.name: Gruul Locket
quotes.flavor:
"In life, it was a cunning survivor, fearless and quick. May its power pass to you as you wear its skull."
—Gna, Gruul shaman

quotes.name: Painted Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Centuries of scouring sands have carved and polished the rocky terrain of the Shefet.

quotes.name: Temple of Malady
quotes.flavor: The world ended, yet the ads kept rolling.

quotes.name: Reconnaissance Mission
quotes.flavor:
"The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything."
—Jirina Kudro

quotes.name: Kaervek the Merciless
quotes.flavor:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

quotes.name: Meandering Towershell
quotes.flavor: The wait is proportional to the weight.

quotes.name: Leave in the Dust
quotes.flavor: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

quotes.name: Rain of Thorns
quotes.flavor: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

quotes.name: Wrench Mind
quotes.flavor: What is the sound of one head snapping?

quotes.name: Rend Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"The battle at Ganzan Pass was a testament to human endurance. The untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami, leaving more than their share of slain foes in their wake."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Goblin Bird-Grabber
quotes.flavor: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

quotes.name: Deathbonnet Sprout // Deathbonnet Hulk
quotes.flavor: They grow up so fast.

quotes.name: Bloodline Shaman
quotes.flavor: Every creature of the forest has a name, and she knows them all.

quotes.name: Conviction
quotes.flavor: "There is no greater coward than one who believes in nothing."

quotes.name: Benalish Sleeper
quotes.flavor: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.

quotes.name: Mesa Cavalier
quotes.flavor: In the fight to defeat Phyrexia, the courage of Benalish knights is matched only by that of their pegasus steeds.

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.flavor: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

quotes.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Her centuries-long search is ended.

quotes.name: Rosa, Resolute White Mage
quotes.flavor: "I have no regrets for becoming a white mage and fighting alongside a brave knight."

quotes.name: Lo and Li, Twin Tutors
quotes.flavor: "Almost perfect," Lo began. Li finished, "One hair out of place."

quotes.name: Krark-Clan Ironworks
quotes.flavor: All the junk, refuse, and offal of the Krark Clan is diligently collected, melted down, and made into more junk, refuse, and offal.

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

quotes.name: Protector of the Crown
quotes.flavor: "I gladly offer my weapon and my life to the glory of my sovereign."

quotes.name: Dutiful Return
quotes.flavor:
"We have a word for enemies too mutilated for military service: furniture."
—Taigam, Sidisi's Hand

quotes.name: Straw Soldiers
quotes.flavor: The overnight appearance of miles of "armed" Wu forts at Guangling frightened a much vaster Wei force into fleeing for their lives.

quotes.name: Frostbite Pyromental
quotes.flavor: It's a contradiction in burns.

quotes.name: Elvish Archers
quotes.flavor: The archers have a reputation for attacking without warning. They claim that the first arrow *is* the warning.

quotes.name: Worst Fears
quotes.flavor: It's absolutely time for a blow out.

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.flavor: Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.

quotes.name: Vorapede
quotes.flavor:
"If you think you've killed one, guess again."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Compelling Argument
quotes.flavor:
"How can there be doubt in the presence of such blessings?"
—Ukhat, vizier of initiation

quotes.name: Phial of Galadriel
quotes.flavor: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out."

quotes.name: Frostboil Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"We're on the Thames. The last great Frost Fair. 1814, February the 4th."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

quotes.name: Mana Skimmer
quotes.flavor: They traverse the mana-starved wastes in search of richer lands.

quotes.name: Wight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

quotes.name: Lavabrink Venturer
quotes.flavor: "Take one wrong step out here and you're dead. I take only right steps."

quotes.name: Angelsong
quotes.flavor: Clash of sword and cry of beast fall mute when angels sound the call to prayer.

quotes.name: Deadbridge Goliath
quotes.flavor: Some Golgari insects live for centuries—and they never stop growing.

quotes.name: Ascended Lawmage
quotes.flavor: A lawmage's runic script is an act of governance given form: legislation written directly onto the air itself.

quotes.name: Turtle Lair
quotes.flavor: Home is where your pizza delivers.

quotes.name: Built to Last
quotes.flavor: Consulate-built automatons have a lifetime warranty.

quotes.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
quotes.flavor: "I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"

quotes.name: Solemn Simulacrum
quotes.flavor:
"What purpose does emulating humans serve except to remind you that you are incomplete?"
—Lal, to Data

quotes.name: Dakmor Lancer
quotes.flavor: The darkness of his shield reflects the inky blackness of his soul.

quotes.name: Kari Zev, Skyship Raider
quotes.flavor: Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.

quotes.name: Yeva, Nature's Herald
quotes.flavor: "I can call an army to my side in the blink of an eye. Best not blink."

quotes.name: Drooling Ogre
quotes.flavor:
"Is it the stomping kind or the munching kind?"
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

quotes.name: Axgard Cavalry
quotes.flavor:
Riding the goat
—Dwarven expression meaning
"a foolhardy act of bravery"

quotes.name: Battle Rampart
quotes.flavor:
"I will build no sanctuaries. The safety you seek can be won only by the sword."
—Yannash, outpost builder

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: The Nipton Lottery
quotes.flavor: Oliver Swanick won the only lottery that matters: a chance to live another day.

quotes.name: Overwhelm
quotes.flavor: "Let the song of Selesnya be heard above the rhythm of our thundering hordes!"

quotes.name: Edge Rover
quotes.flavor: Charting the Edge, one scan at a time.

quotes.name: Cradle of the Accursed
quotes.flavor: Many such monuments dot the wasteland known as Ifnir.

quotes.name: Bewilder
quotes.flavor:
"Teferi snapped his fingers, and the viashino started clucking like a chicken. Silly, yes, but exactly the thing we needed to break the stifling tension."
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Impact Tremors
quotes.flavor: "The only chance we have of getting out of this world is if we take care of Venger once and for all!"

quotes.name: Joint Exploration
quotes.flavor: The Tolarians had the maps, but only the Yavimayans knew how to read them.

quotes.name: Talisman of Creativity
quotes.flavor: "Well? Isn't anyone going to ask what is it with the glasses?"

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor:
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Sadistic Glee
quotes.flavor:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Teferi's Moat
quotes.flavor:
"Isolation is not the answer."
—Urza, to Teferi

quotes.name: Skirge Familiar
quotes.flavor: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

quotes.name: Instant Ramen
quotes.flavor: "It's not about finding the single best ingredient. It's about crafting that perfect blend of meat, egg, and shrimp. That harmony of flavors is key."

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.flavor: "Rich" is a relative term.

quotes.name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
quotes.flavor: OWNER AND STAR OF HELLBENDER. A TRENDSETTER IN BOTH FASHION AND VIOLENCE.

quotes.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
quotes.flavor: "Aha! Yes! Now I hear it, the beautiful poetry of the lights in the sky. I must reach the moon and ask what it all means!"

quotes.name: Sigiled Starfish
quotes.flavor: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

quotes.name: Mons's Goblin Raiders
quotes.flavor: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

quotes.name: Blood Servitor
quotes.flavor:
"Please, my friends, help yourselves to the help."
—Olivia Voldaren

quotes.name: Combine Chrysalis
quotes.flavor:
"What do you want to be, now that you're grown up?"
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Kirol, Attentive First-Year
quotes.flavor: Kirol hated being a pawn in Morcant's game. If dawnglove was as potent as she suggested, it should be preserved, not used to tip the balance of power.

quotes.name: Tribute to the World Tree
quotes.flavor:
"The Tree was the heart of our world. It made me what I am and pulled me back from the brink of death. I won't allow it to be forgotten."
—Esika, god of the Tree

quotes.name: Vault of Whispers
quotes.flavor: Heretic cultures came to planet Sovereign in search of resources and precious artifacts. They found something else.

quotes.name: Frostburn Weird
quotes.flavor: Many chemisters are oblivious to the innumerable machinations of their guild, instead focusing obsessively on creating the perfect weird.

quotes.name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
quotes.flavor: The samurai struck the fragile-looking bubble, and her sword shattered into countless pieces.

quotes.name: Old Guard
quotes.flavor: "You say you're capable of flying. You got any proof of that?"

quotes.name: Primordial Sage
quotes.flavor: For each creature that arrives in its audience, the sage imparts another piece of ancient wisdom for all to hear.

quotes.name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
quotes.flavor: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

quotes.name: Ark of Hunger
quotes.flavor: Few relics survived the turmoil of the Blood Age; those that did are powerful, dangerous, or both.

quotes.name: Viridian Revel
quotes.flavor: Some delights are best enjoyed in company.

quotes.name: River Boa
quotes.flavor:
"Sheath your swords! Cudgels only. I see a new pair of waterproof trek boots slithering away."
—Nablus, North Hada trapper

quotes.name: Havengul Runebinder
quotes.flavor: "So many corpses, so little time."

quotes.name: Skittering Skirge
quotes.flavor: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

quotes.name: Seizan, Perverter of Truth
quotes.flavor:
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate."
—Records of the Living Historians

quotes.name: Bloodrock Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

quotes.name: Finale of Eternity
quotes.flavor: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: If your flesh can withstand the flame, the spirit of the dragon will burn within your soul.

quotes.name: Savannah Lions
quotes.flavor:
"One alone is fearsome; one among many is unstoppable."
—Benalish proverb

quotes.name: Echoing Truth
quotes.flavor: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

quotes.name: Mesa Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

quotes.name: Valakut Invoker
quotes.flavor:
"As long as we have walked this world, we have known it as a harsh and unforgiving place."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Swiftwater Cliffs
quotes.flavor: In its attempts to mirror Tzeentch's convoluted scheming, the Crystal Labyrinth constantly shifts and rearranges itself.

quotes.name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
quotes.flavor: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

quotes.name: Desperate Farmer // Depraved Harvester
quotes.flavor: A tragic moment pushed him to a blasphemous act.

quotes.name: Siegecraft
quotes.flavor:
"They thought their fortress impregnable . . . until we marched up with ours, and blocked out the sun."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

quotes.name: Stronghold Discipline
quotes.flavor:
"Crovax never passes up an opportunity to cause widespread misery."
—Belbe

quotes.name: Malfegor
quotes.flavor: A demon cannot be trusted, and a dragon will not be ruled.

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
quotes.flavor: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

quotes.name: Into the Fire
quotes.flavor: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.

quotes.name: Dark Bargain
quotes.flavor: Under Ormendahl's demonic influence, Bishop Jerren became the perfect agent of bloody blasphemy.

quotes.name: Thumbscrews
quotes.flavor:
"We will start small, I think."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Woodland Champion
quotes.flavor: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

quotes.name: Maelstrom Archangel
quotes.flavor: There is no world where angels fear to tread.

quotes.name: Baxter Building
quotes.flavor:
"Home sweet home, until it gets teleported to the Negative Zone again or somethin'."
—The Thing, Ben Grimm

quotes.name: Blacklance Paragon
quotes.flavor: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

quotes.name: Hanweir Garrison // Hanweir, the Writhing Township
quotes.flavor: "We're ready for anything!"

quotes.name: Goblin Mime
quotes.flavor: Pretending to be inside an invisible box was easy enough for Brug. It was finding the invisible door that caused him problems.

quotes.name: Kami of Old Stone
quotes.flavor:
"There was a wall here. Now it is dust. A tower rose here. Now it is fallen. An army fought here. Now it is dead. A spirit was here. It is all that remains."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: Sage of Lat-Nam
quotes.flavor: Within each device is a spark of its creator's soul. Within each sage is a lamp that awaits that spark.

quotes.name: Relic Amulet
quotes.flavor: Old power finds new purpose.

quotes.name: Anvilwrought Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"I know its lightness, for I have seen it fly. I know its weight, for I have seen it strike."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

quotes.name: Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff
quotes.flavor: "They tell me now that I'm an Avenger I can't kill anyone. You want to put that to the test?"

quotes.name: Watercourser
quotes.flavor:
"Beware an eddy where there should be none or a stretch that flows too fast or too slow."
—Old Fishbones, Martyne river guide

quotes.name: Suspicious Bookcase
quotes.flavor: The great library in the Museum of Old Capenna has a million volumes on display—and miles of passages hidden behind them.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Tyvar the Bellicose
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: "Today, we become gods again."

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor:
"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?"
—Sabalom Glitz

quotes.name: Justiciar's Portal
quotes.flavor: With the new guildmaster's innovations, arresters can arrive on the scene moments before a crime is committed.

quotes.name: Lothlórien Lookout
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"That was the custom of the Elves of Lórien, to dwell in the trees. Therefore they were called Galadhrim, the Tree-people."
—Legolas

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Banshee
quotes.flavor: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

quotes.name: End-Raze Forerunners
quotes.flavor:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Amateur Auteur
quotes.flavor:
So Griselbrand was bound,
his rage brought to a halt.
'Til Lili Vess came 'round
asking, "Hey, what's in the vault?"
—*INNISTRAD! The Musical*

quotes.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
quotes.flavor: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: "I have a plan. Actually, I have three."

quotes.name: Mirrormere Guardian
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"But still the sunken stars appear
In dark and windless Mirrormere;
There lies his crown in water deep,
Till Durin wakes again from sleep."
—Gimli's song

quotes.name: Shanna, Purifying Blade
quotes.flavor: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life. Now it was time to forge her own.

quotes.name: Fierce Retribution
quotes.flavor: "It won't bring them back, but it will bring me peace."

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"Once I saw a goblin shouting at a thunderstorm. He lost the argument pretty quickly."
—Wandering mage

quotes.name: Heroic Intervention
quotes.flavor:
"Another beautiful day in the most dangerous place in the world."
—Nick Valentine

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

quotes.name: Gloom Pangolin
quotes.flavor:
"They say it survives on a purely bioluminescent diet. It's only active during the darkest of Indatha nights, making verification highly challenging."
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

quotes.name: Font of Mythos
quotes.flavor: Those who drink from Malfegor's cup are tainted with hunger and stained with lies.

quotes.name: Chain Assassination
quotes.flavor:
"Who needs stealth when there's no one left to raise the alarm?"
—Jacob Frye

quotes.name: Goblin Spy
quotes.flavor:
"Isn't he on our side?"
"Yep."
"Why's he spyin' on us?"
"Don't ask."

quotes.name: Daring Apprentice
quotes.flavor: In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.

quotes.name: Archetype of Imagination
quotes.flavor:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

quotes.name: Goblin Welder
quotes.flavor: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

quotes.name: Murmuring Mystic
quotes.flavor: Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: In the Blue Area of the moon lies a garden sculpted by alien hands, where the one called the Watcher stands witness.

quotes.name: Shao Jun
quotes.flavor: "I shall walk in the darkness and strike swiftly. No one will stop me in my hunt."

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: From the heart of the mountain into the heart of the mage.

quotes.name: Blighted Gorge
quotes.flavor: The land is dying, but it will not go peacefully.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Pegasus Charger
quotes.flavor:
"The clouds came alive and dove to the earth! Hooves flashed among the dark army, who fled before the spectacle of fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 211

quotes.name: Imaginary Pet
quotes.flavor: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

quotes.name: Ravenous Leucrocota
quotes.flavor: Hunger makes a leucrocota dangerous. A full belly makes it angry and dangerous.

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Enhanced Surveillance
quotes.flavor:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Skoa, Embermage
quotes.flavor: "I need kindling. You'll do nicely."

quotes.name: Theft of Dreams
quotes.flavor: Energy is never lost, only transformed.

quotes.name: Expedition Map
quotes.flavor:
"Let's have a look at the map. Okay, let's see. We are right about here. I can mark it up as we go."
—Chloe Frazer

quotes.name: Sporemound
quotes.flavor:
"If you threaten its territory, it produces spores. Actually, no matter what you do, it produces spores."
—Hadi Kasten, Calla Dale naturalist

quotes.name: Zoologist
quotes.flavor: "With friends like these, who needs people?"

quotes.name: Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep
quotes.flavor: The keep was called the Hornburg, for a trumpet sounded upon the tower echoed in the Deep behind, as if armies long-forgotten were issuing to war from caves beneath the hills.

quotes.name: No Witnesses
quotes.flavor: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

quotes.name: Aether Shockwave
quotes.flavor:
"The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War. Strange happenings that neither side could control lashed out across Kamigawa."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Ring of Gix
quotes.flavor: Not every cage is made of bars.

quotes.name: Abaddon the Despoiler
quotes.flavor: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Armed Response
quotes.flavor: Raksha watched as the goblins continued to pour onto the Razor Fields. "They just don't know when to stop, do they?"

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Paradise Druid
quotes.flavor: "There are many kinds of duty, and mine is to see our world grow and endure."

quotes.name: Displacer Kitten
quotes.flavor:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

quotes.name: Force of Will
quotes.flavor:
「愛する人を守るには、大切なものを手放す覚悟を決めねばならぬ。」
――「戦時の唄」

quotes.name: Moan of the Unhallowed
quotes.flavor: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

quotes.name: Call the Cavalry
quotes.flavor: Benalish citizens born under the same constellations share a star-clan. Their loyalty to one another interlaces the Seven Houses.

quotes.name: Spider-Punk
quotes.flavor: "Disrespect authority. Smash the system."

quotes.name: Nighthawk Scavenger
quotes.flavor: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

quotes.name: Savannah Sage
quotes.flavor: "Now is not the time for your light to fade."

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: Some days, it just feels like trash. Other days, it could really go for some people.

quotes.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
quotes.flavor: He bids his minions rise from their graves to their knees.

quotes.name: Liliana Vess // Liliana Vess
quotes.flavor: Right Field

quotes.name: Fireslinger
quotes.flavor:
"One pain is lessened by another's anguish."
—William Shakespeare, *Romeo and Juliet*

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor:
「どうやってそれを手に入れたのだ？ いや、気にするな。答えは聞きたくない。」
—-ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

quotes.name: Treacherous Blessing
quotes.flavor: Phenax is generous with gifts and unforgiving of debts.

quotes.name: Phantom General
quotes.flavor: After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Scathe Zombies
quotes.flavor:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Moldering Karok
quotes.flavor: Necroluminescence is common among the undead creatures of Sedgemoor, giving the midnight swamp an eerie glow. It's comforting—from a distance.

quotes.name: Tarmogoyf
quotes.flavor: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

quotes.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
quotes.flavor:
"NYAH HA HA HA!"
—Skeletor

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Child of Night
quotes.flavor: Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.

quotes.name: Pirate's Prize
quotes.flavor: Nothing warms the heart like plunder.

quotes.name: Join the Dance
quotes.flavor: "We can go into the dark hand-in-hand or alone. I know which I prefer."

quotes.name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
quotes.flavor: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.

quotes.name: Farseek
quotes.flavor: Eumidians live to change and be changed, ever increasing the complexity of the Edge. Each new world is a new perspective.

quotes.name: Wrack with Madness
quotes.flavor: The skathul, spirits consumed by revenge, fester and seethe while looking for weak minds to assault.

quotes.name: Bull Cerodon
quotes.flavor: It holds motionless vigil, watching Naya in silence through the screen of the whitecover. When it senses anything amiss, it launches forward with the uncanny sound of torn fog.

quotes.name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
quotes.flavor:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Orzhov Enforcer
quotes.flavor: "You'll pay what you owe, with your money or your life."

quotes.name: Island
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You're about to disembark to find the harbormaster when you spot a merfolk darting underneath your ship.

quotes.name: The Bear Force Pilot Runner
quotes.flavor:
MR 9/19: So you're saying your plan is to errata a previous Unknown card to have this new mechanic now? Will they even notice?
GV 9/23: Don't worry, I'll fix it in the flavor text.

quotes.name: Havoc Jester
quotes.flavor: To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.

quotes.name: Stonewood Invoker
quotes.flavor: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Pillar of the Paruns
quotes.flavor: Built on the very ground where the Ten signed the Guildpact, the tower is a monument to the past and a reminder of who holds power in the present.

quotes.name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
quotes.flavor: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

quotes.name: Shivan Wumpus
quotes.flavor: It's easier to move the village than to divert the wumpus.

quotes.name: Pristine Talisman
quotes.flavor:
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate."
—Elspeth Tirel

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord
